sourceCopy.name: Body Surface Area Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Body Surface Area Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Estimate adult body surface area with Mosteller and Du Bois formulas. Free, local calculations with metric or US units.
sourceCopy.intro: Enter height and weight to compare two common body-surface-area estimates. Formula results can differ; this is math information, not medical guidance.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How is body surface area estimated?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Mosteller uses the square root of height in centimeters times weight in kilograms divided by 3,600. Du Bois uses a different height-and-weight equation. Both return an estimate in square meters.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The estimates run in this browser. Measurements are not saved or uploaded.

fields.accuracyNote: Adult estimate only. Supported range: 50–250 cm and 10–500 kg, including equivalent US units.
fields.safetyNote: Do not use these estimates for medication doses, diagnosis or treatment decisions. Follow a qualified healthcare professional’s instructions. Not intended for children.
fields.formulaNote: Mosteller: √(height cm × weight kg ÷ 3,600). Du Bois: 0.007184 × weight kg^0.425 × height cm^0.725. Results are estimates, not direct measurements.

actions.privacyNote: Names and pairings stay on this device.

additionalFaqs.question: Why do the formulas give different results?
additionalFaqs.answer: Each formula models height and weight differently. The displayed difference is arithmetic, not a measure of which formula is right for a particular person.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I use body surface area to calculate a medicine dose?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. Do not use this page to choose or change a dose. Use only instructions from a qualified healthcare professional.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this calculator work for children?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It is presented only as an adult estimate and does not implement pediatric formulas or clinical interpretation.
